name: Mandarin Oriental Bangkok
tagline: The legendary riverside hotel, a living piece of history
taglineZh: 湄南河畔的传奇酒店，一部活着的历史
description: Since 1876, the Mandarin Oriental has hosted royalty, novelists and film stars on the banks of the Chao Phraya. Butler-serviced rooms, the authors' wing, an award-winning spa and world-class afternoon tea define timeless Bangkok luxury.
descriptionZh: 自1876年起，文华东方酒店接待过无数皇室、文豪与影星，坐落于湄南河畔。管家服务客房、作家翼、屡获殊荣的水疗与经典下午茶，定义了曼谷的永恒奢华。

name: The Siam Hotel
tagline: Art deco riverside retreat with private pool villas
taglineZh: 装饰艺术风格的河畔私邸，私人泳池别墅
description: The Siam is a serene Art Deco hideaway along the Chao Phraya in Dusit. All 39 rooms and villas enjoy private pools or plunge pools, and the hotel offers a free boat shuttle to the BTS, plus a beautiful Muay Thai gym and spa.
descriptionZh: 暹罗酒店是位于律实区湄南河畔的宁静装饰艺术风隐居之所。39 间客房与别墅均配私人泳池或泡池，酒店提供免费接驳船直达 BTS，另有泰拳馆与水疗中心。

name: Park Hyatt Bangkok
tagline: Sleek design hotel above Central Embassy mall
taglineZh: 中央大使馆商场之上的时尚设计酒店
description: Park Hyatt Bangkok occupies the crown of the Central Embassy complex on Ploenchit Road. Sculptural architecture, a rooftop infinity pool with city views and direct skywalk access to the BTS make it a favourite for design lovers and shoppers.
descriptionZh: 柏悦酒店位于奔集路 Central Embassy 综合体顶部。雕塑感建筑、可俯瞰城市天际线的屋顶无边泳池，以及天桥直达 BTS，深受设计与购物爱好者青睐。

location.address: 88/1 Witthayu Rd, Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Bangkok 10330
